title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Hanscom Air Force Base.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: First Amendment to 365-day Firm Transportation Service Agreement by and between Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid and Hanscom Air Force Base dated 5/29/2008. By Thomas P. O'Neill. DPU 08-GC-8.

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-8.
